title: EPMotion - DNA Extraction
author: Khai-Minh H Nguyen
materials: Create 565 µL aliquots of 1M DTT Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #43816 into 1.5mL tubes Store DTT at -20 °C Note: Note: 1 Aliquot will provide enough reagent for 1 plate.
In the epBlue Studio, open the Application Editor.
Import the epblue protocol Agencourt DNAdvanced Extraction.export7

DNA Extraction Worktable Setup Set up EPmotion following the worktable figure above. Place 300ul EPmotion tip rack on positions A2, A3, B1-B4 without tip rack lid. Place 300ul EPmotion tip rack on positions B0 and C4 with tip rack lid. Place 50ul EPmotion tip rack on position B5 without tip rack lid. Place eppendorf Thermoadapter PCR 96 on position C3 Place eppendorf magnum FLX magnet on position C2 Ensure Tip waste basket is empty and liquid waste reservoir is empty.
Close epMotion hood when all tips/plates/reagents are in position
Select your EPmotion ID and press "Next"
Ensure that the volumes of the reagents are set to: Bind 1 - 25000ul Bind 2 - 25000ul EtOH 1 - 30000ul EtOH 2 - 30000ul EtOH 3 - 30000ul Elution Buffer - 25000ul
Select your EPmotion ID and press "Next"

steps.title: Prepare master lysis mix
steps.instruction: Add 15.18 mL Lysis Buffer (Beckman Coulter Genomics, Cat #C42203) to a new 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Make proteinase K aliquots
steps.instruction: Download the DNAdvance Handbook (PN B66866AC) from Beckman Coulter Genomics, prepare Proteinase K solution as described on page 9, aliquot 785 µL into 1.5 mL tubes, and store at –20 °C (one aliquot per 96‑well plate).

steps.title: Add proteinase K to master mix
steps.instruction: Add 770 µL Proteinase K to the 50 mL Falcon tube containing the Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Add DTT to master mix
steps.instruction: Add 550 µL DTT to the same Falcon tube.

steps.title: Mix master mix
steps.instruction: Shake vigorously and vortex for 30 seconds, then place on ice for 3 minutes to allow bubbles to settle.

steps.title: Dispense master mix to plate
steps.instruction: Pour the master mix into a reagent reservoir, then use a multichannel pipette to add 150 µL to each well of the deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Spin down lysed samples
steps.instruction: If the deep‑well plate containing processed samples is frozen, defrost on ice; then spin at 2500 rpm for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Seal and re‑spin plate
steps.instruction: Cover the plate with a Square sealing mat (Cat. AB0675), ensure all wells are tightly sealed, and spin again at 2500 rpm for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate on Thermomixer
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate on a Thermomixer C with plate attachment and lid, incubate overnight (12–20 h) at 55 °C, 900 rpm.

steps.title: Open epMotion protocol
steps.instruction: Launch the epBlue application and open the protocol named “Agencourt DNAdvanced Extraction.”

steps.title: Equilibrate magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Allow Bind BBE magnetic beads (Beckman Coulter Genomics) to reach room temperature for 30 minutes; verify that at least 25 mL beads are present in the 50 mL Falcon tube aliquoted earlier.

steps.title: Aliquot and resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Aliquot Bind BBE beads into 50 mL Falcon tubes for ease of use, then vortex and shake thoroughly so no beads remain pelleted.

steps.title: Label epMotion reservoirs
steps.instruction: Label the 7 × 30 mL reservoir rack as follows: 1 × “Bind 1”, 1 × “Beads”, 3 × “70 % EtOH”, 1 × “EB”, and 1 × “Empty”.

steps.title: Add Pre‑Bind solution
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL Pre‑Bind PBBA (Beckman Coulter Genomics) to the reservoir labeled “Bind 1” and place this reservoir at position 1 of the epMotion reagent rack.

steps.title: Add Elution solution
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL Elution EBA (Beckman Coulter Genomics) to the reservoir labeled “EB” and place it at position 6.

steps.title: Prepare 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: In two clean 50 mL Falcon tubes, mix 35 mL 100 % ethanol with 15 mL ultrapure, nuclease‑free water to make 50 mL of 70 % ethanol each (total 100 mL).

steps.title: Load ethanol reservoirs
steps.instruction: Add 30 mL of the 70 % ethanol to each of the three reservoirs labeled “70 % EtOH” and place them at positions 3, 4, 5 of the epMotion rack.

steps.title: Place empty reservoir
steps.instruction: Place the reservoir labeled “Empty” onto position 7 of the epMotion rack.

steps.title: Resuspend Bind BBE beads
steps.instruction: Shake and vortex the 50 mL tube of Bind BBE beads for 5 minutes to eliminate any pellet.

steps.title: Load beads into reservoir
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL Bind BBE beads to the reservoir labeled “Beads” and place it at position 2.

steps.title: Position reagent rack
steps.instruction: Remove lids from all reagent reservoirs (including the empty one) and place the reservoir rack onto position C5 of the epMotion worktable.

steps.title: Position deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Remove the deep‑well plate from the Thermomixer, spin down, remove the sealing mat, and place the plate (letters/numbers right‑side‑up) on position C1 of the worktable.

steps.title: Set up elution plate
steps.instruction: Take a new MicroAmp™ Optical 96‑Well Reaction Plate (Catalog No. 4306737), label with the deep‑well plate name, your initials, and the date, then place it on the thermoadapter at position C3 (correct orientation).

steps.title: Start epMotion run
steps.instruction: Press the Play button, select “Input volumes manually”, press Next, choose “Set all volumes”, enter 200 µL, press Next again, then press Run.

steps.title: Mid‑run bead capture
steps.instruction: When the robot pauses for user intervention, spin down the deep‑well plate, return it to the magnetic module, pulse‑centrifuge, then press OK to resume.

steps.title: Collect eluted DNA
steps.instruction: After the run finishes, open the hood, remove the elution plate from position C3, seal with a PCR adhesive seal, place on a DynaMag‑96 side magnet at 4 °C, and leave overnight.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 180 µL of the clear supernatant to a new MicroAmp™ Optical 96‑Well Reaction Plate (Catalog No. 4306737) labeled identically; if beads remain, wait longer before transfer and avoid bead carry‑over.

steps.title: Seal and mix transferred plate
steps.instruction: Seal the new plate, shake briefly, and spin down.

steps.title: Nanodrop quantification
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration on a Nanodrop using Elution EBA as the blank; save only the values table and name the file with the DNA plate code and date.

steps.title: Record results in database
steps.instruction: Open the Extraction Database (Google Sheet) created in the Sample Cutting/Processing Protocol, paste the Nanodrop concentration, 260/280 and 260/230 values into columns H‑J, enter the extraction date in column G, and enter the plate barcode in column B.
